Solana vote program execution, state updates, and account management.

# Purpose
This file implements the vote program execution logic for a Solana-style runtime. It decodes vote instructions, checks required accounts and sysvars, verifies signer authority, and updates vote account state. The code handles the main vote program operations, including `InitializeAccount`, `Authorize`, `AuthorizeWithSeed`, `UpdateValidatorIdentity`, `UpdateCommission`, `Vote`, `UpdateVoteState`, `TowerSync`, and `Withdraw`. It also contains the entry point [`fd_vote_program_execute`](<#fd_vote_program_execute>), which dispatches each instruction to the correct handler after it reads and validates the instruction data.

The file also contains the vote account state management code used by those instructions. It supports multiple vote state versions, converts older state formats to the current format, manages authorized voters with a treap and pool, tracks lockouts and rooted votes, computes vote credits, and filters proposed vote state updates against slot hash history. In addition, it provides public helper APIs such as [`fd_vote_get_state`](<#fd_vote_get_state>), [`fd_vote_convert_to_current`](<#fd_vote_convert_to_current>), and [`fd_vote_store_account`](<#fd_vote_store_account>) for use by other parts of the executor and bank code.
